subject: Malaysia M-510 pigment for Aalterpaint's coating review
body:
Aalterpaint develops industrial and packaging coatings, including Acrydur HB polyurethane finishes.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its TDS specifies zirconium/aluminium surface treatment and lists wall latex paints; suitability for your industrial formulations would need your team's assessment.

May I send the M-510 technical sheet to your purchasing and formulation teams for an initial assessment?
